services.desc: A pool party is the ultimate celebration. Montgomery County Recreation is proud to host dozens of birthday parties and other gatherings, and we're excited to help you host your next event. No matter your age, you'll have fun racing down the water slide, jumping off the diving board or swimming in the pool! After you've had your fill of the pool, you can keep the party going in one of our rentable spaces. Cost: Covers one hour of room use and admissions for up to 25 kids and five adults. Due to staff shortages, areas of the facility may not be available at the time of rental. blurb: Located within the South Germantown Recreational Park in Boyds, Germantown Indoor Swim Center is fully programmed daily and on weekends. Available activities include lap swimming, recreational swimming, water fitness classes, swim lessons, scuba, swim team and dive team classes.
